title: Add Google Login
description: Deterministic feature-change scenario for adding Google login and redirecting signed-in users to their profile.

prompt.rawPrompt: Add Google login and redirect users to profile after successful sign in.

refinement.understood: Add a Google sign-in option to the existing auth surface and route successful sign-ins to the profile page.
ambiguities: Whether the production OAuth credentials are already configured.
Whether the profile redirect should apply to all providers or only Google.
suggestions: Reuse the existing auth route and auth helper instead of introducing a second auth stack.
Keep the login page as the primary user-facing entry point.
Treat /profile as the post-login destination for this demo path.
